question: True or false: more than 10,000 shipping containers fall overboard in an average year?
answer: False. The World Shipping Council's surveys put average losses since 2008 under 1,500 a year, with 221 lost in 2023 and 576 in 2024, when ships rerouted round the stormy Cape. Over 250 million boxes are carried each year. A single ship spilling hundreds in a storm makes most of a bad year.
move: Count the whole traffic before judging the size of the spill.
trap: Recalling the rubber ducks and trainers washed up after famous spills.

diagram.caption: Under 1,500 lost a year, out of more than 250 million carried.
